defect: The fix makes Cycle compute the residual via MultAtLevel so a later-added timed subclass counts operator applications.
reason: At this commit MultAtLevel and GetOperatorAtLevel()->Mult were equivalent; the counting override was only added later in 28f9c87.

defect: Turning MFEM_ASSERT into MFEM_VERIFY on GetNumGeometries(dim) makes FiniteElementSpace construction abort in all builds on meshes with no elements (e.g. empty MPI ranks).
reason: The changed line promoted a debug-only check that is false for empty meshes into an always-on abort, and the fix relaxes exactly that check.

defect: The fix removes a redundant include of restriction.hpp from pfespace.hpp as part of cleaning up include dependencies; the real build problem was in restriction.cpp/hpp.
reason: fespace.hpp already included restriction.hpp, so the added include in pfespace.hpp was harmless and its removal is cleanup.

defect: The new SQUARE and CUBE PhysNodeFinder kernels index the shared dists/ref_buf arrays (size max_team_x) by the point index i, which runs up to nq, instead of the thread id, overflowing them and storing the wrong reference point.
reason: The SQUARE/CUBE bodies were added by this change (copied from SEGMENT) and the fix replaces exactly those i indices with MFEM_THREAD_ID(x).

defect: Debug edit replaced bel_to_IJK orientation-aware indices (okv>=0 ? i : -1-i) with plain i and j, losing the reversed-orientation encoding for 3D boundary elements.
reason: The fix restores exactly the lines this change commented out.

defect: eval_cons returns w*x - a while get_cons_info sets the bounds to a, so the constraint enforced is w*x = 2a.
reason: The pre-change code already computed w_*x - a_ with the same bounds; the change only rewrote it as wtx - a_.

defect: The fix reformats code, constifies locals and removes unused variables to silence warnings.
reason: The fix is a style/warnings cleanup with no behavioural change to the metrics this change added.

defect: The fix wraps a long declaration line for code style.
reason: Pure style fix.

defect: The benchmark passes fractional probabilities (0.01, 0.1, 0.5) through Google Benchmark's integer state.range(), so they truncate to 0 and the AMR probabilities are wrong.
reason: The fix replaces the newly added fractional args with integer percentages divided by 100.

defect: HYPRE_Init() is guarded by MFEM_HYPRE_VERSION >= 21500, but the no-argument HYPRE_Init is only available from hypre 2.19, so builds with hypre 2.15-2.18 still fail.
reason: Before the change HYPRE_Init() was called unconditionally, so builds with those hypre versions already failed; the change narrowed but did not create the failure.

defect: The added line registers a second '-p' option bound to an undeclared variable 'visport' (the field is opt.visport, already registered), which fails to compile or duplicates the option.
reason: The fix deletes exactly the line this change added.

defect: The fix changes the 3D LoadX signature to take a DeviceTensor, a follow-up to a later signature change (5ae5264) that made the array-reference parameter incompatible with callers.
reason: The DeviceCube to DeviceTensor<3> replacement in this change is equivalent; the incompatibility was introduced by a later commit.

defect: The fix passes a DeviceTensor X instead of sm0[2] to LoadX, to match the signature changed by the later commit 5ae5264.
reason: This change only added the internal:: namespace qualifier; with the signature of that time, the sm0[2] call compiled and worked.

defect: The fix reformats whitespace and braces and renames a shadowing local edge_dofs to local_edge_dofs.
reason: The shadowing variable was used consistently in its scope, so the fix changes no behaviour.

defect: The fix reformats declarations and adds documentation.
reason: Pure format and documentation fix.

defect: The fix wraps the ReduceMarked signature and removes trailing whitespace.
reason: Ignoring whitespace, the fix changes only line wrapping.

defect: The added 'row_starts == NULL' test is dead because row_starts was already reassigned from the matrix above, so row_starts[2] is still read out of bounds when no row_starts were given.
reason: The out-of-bounds read pre-existed; this change tried to fix it ineffectively, and the follow-up makes that fix actually work.

defect: After moving the reduction from forall_smem (which had a serial host path) to forall_2D, the kernel still indexes with MFEM_BLOCK_ID(x), which is 0 on host, and the outer index parameter is shadowed by the loop's idx, so the reduction partitions the work wrongly.
reason: The fix replaces MFEM_BLOCK_ID(x) with the work index in the operator() that this change rewrote.

defect: In H1_PyramidElement::CalcDShape, expressions like '-1.0 + (z<1.0) ? a : 0.0' parse as '(-1.0 + (z<1.0)) ? a : 0.0' because of '?:' precedence, giving wrong derivatives (and dshape(1,0) also has the wrong sign).
reason: The fix parenthesizes exactly the newly added ternary expressions.

defect: The new GetBareDofs maps edges always to ghost-dof offsets (ndofs+ngvdofs+index*ne) regardless of whether the edge is regular or ghost, and GetBareFaceDofs is an empty TODO.
reason: The fix rewrites GetBareDofs, which this change introduced, to distinguish regular and ghost entities and to handle faces.

defect: The Mult kernel reads the member use_abs_diag inside MFEM_FORALL (capturing 'this' on device) and calls std::abs in device code, which breaks HIP builds and can fail on CUDA.
reason: The fix moves the abs handling to Setup with a local copy of the flag, replacing exactly the device-side code this change added.

defect: The fix removes variable shadowing (inner redeclarations of j, k, v0, v1) in the new edge-to-knot code.
reason: The shadowing declarations did not change behaviour; this is a warning cleanup.

defect: The new TetDofOrd loops run to pm2 and use pm3 and offsets for p-2 instead of the tetrahedron interior-dof size (p-3), so the interior dof permutations index wrongly.
reason: The fix corrects the loop bounds and offset formulas of the code this change added.

defect: The DGTrace EA face kernels write with Write() and '=' instead of accumulating, so with several face integrators each one overwrites the previous ones' face matrices.
reason: EABilinearFormExtension::Assemble loops over all face integrators into the same arrays, and the fix switches these new kernels to ReadWrite and '+='.

defect: TransposeIntegrator::AssembleEAInteriorFaces swaps the int0 and int1 blocks when transposing, although each element's own-face block stays on the same side; debug Print calls were also left in.
reason: The fix restores the int0/int1 mapping and removes the debug prints, all in lines this change added.

defect: The new MFEM_DEBUG check in GetEssentialTrueDofs reads ess_tdofs and ess_tdofs2 by host operator[] although BooleanMult/BooleanMultTranspose may leave them valid only on device, which fails in CUDA debug builds.
reason: The fix adds HostRead() to exactly the debug block this change introduced.

defect: In GetNodalValues the fix only moves the loop counter k into the for statements.
reason: Style change with no behavioural effect in this function.

defect: The fix replaces hand-written GLVis socket code with the common VisualizeField/VisualizeMesh helpers and stops opening the socket in the constructor.
reason: This is a refactor onto the shared visualization helpers, not the repair of a specific defect from this change.

defect: EliminateRowCols checks 'if (tmp)' on &GetBlock(i,j), which is never null, so it calls GetBlock on zero blocks (an error), and it double-eliminates diagonal blocks; it also pulls in FiniteElementSpace::ListToMarker into linalg.
reason: The fix rewrites the new function to use IsZeroBlock and a local marker, repairing it for general block matrices.

defect: The new tetrahedron Orient definition lacks the 'const int Geometry::' prefix and InvOrient lacks a terminating semicolon, so geom.cpp does not compile.
reason: The fix adds exactly the missing qualifier and semicolon to lines this change added.

defect: The fix changes 'order <= 0' to 'order < 1', adds comments and adds ParaView output in the shifted diffusion miniapp.
reason: The changes are equivalent, comments or new features; no defect from this change is repaired in this file.

defect: When adding boundary face matrices to element matrices, the new code permutes the face DOF indices by the face orientation, although ea_data_bdr is already in the element's face-lexicographic order, so the entries land at the wrong positions.
reason: The fix removes the permute_face indexing that this change introduced and indexes by the lexicographic face index.

defect: Mesh::AttrToMarker calls attrs.Max() in an assertion, which fails or is undefined for an empty attrs array.
reason: The fix guards exactly that newly added check with attrs.Size() > 0.

defect: The FieldInterpolant constructor leaves the 'setup' flag uninitialized.
reason: The previous default constructor also left 'setup' uninitialized; the change only added the integration-rule argument.

defect: The fix moves dmuz into the inner scope to remove variable shadowing.
reason: Shadowing cleanup; dropping the explicit size 3 is harmless because dmuz is reassigned before use.

defect: The copy constructor initializes usingScaling after elements and shadow, out of declaration order, which triggers -Wreorder and is said to break the mac build.
reason: Behaviour is unchanged and no warnings-as-errors setting is visible in the repository, so whether this was a real build failure on a supported configuration cannot be confirmed.

defect: The new serial unit test declares 'HYPRE_Int size', but HYPRE_Int is undefined in non-MPI builds, so the unit tests fail to compile in serial configurations.
reason: The fix replaces HYPRE_Int with int in the newly added test (and renames its namespace).

defect: ParBlockNonlinearForm::GetGradient now delegates to GetLocalGradient, which offsets the true-dof input with block_offsets instead of block_trueOffsets, so the parallel gradient is evaluated at the wrong state.
reason: Before this change GetGradient used block_trueOffsets itself; the change routed it through the buggy GetLocalGradient, and the fix corrects that offset.

defect: The fix scopes the outer quadrature variables and makes the EA kernel's ir_ea honour the user int_rule.
reason: This change only renamed the shadowing inner 'ir' to 'ir_ea' with identical semantics; ignoring int_rule in that kernel was already the behaviour before.

defect: The fix renames the inner mesh_file string that shadows the outer one to glvis_file and closes the stream explicitly.
reason: The shadowing variable was used consistently and the stream closes on destruction, so behaviour is unchanged.
